scenes.title: Sam sells & delivers on a neighbor's porch
scenes.setting_details: late afternoon golden light, a wooden crate of glass soda bottles on the porch steps

characters.pose: standing on the porch steps at left, handing a glass soda bottle forward with one mitten hand, the other hand holding out an open palm for payment
standing in the open screen doorway at right, reaching out to take the bottle, a coin pinched in his other hand
characters.outfit_note: apron stays on even at home

scenes.action: Sam's first sale: he delivers a bottle of soda to a neighbor's door and gets paid a nickel.
props: wooden crate of 6 glass soda bottles
a single shiny coin between the neighbor's fingers

text_elements.location: the side of the wooden crate

scenes.notes: Place a small vivid green '+5¢' floating above the coin as the only accent.

scenes.title: Sam hands his skeptical sister a stock certificate
scenes.setting_details: evening, the table lamp is the main warm light source

characters.pose: standing on the left third, one arm extended holding an ornate certificate out toward his sister, other arm relaxed at his side
standing on the right third, arms crossed tightly, body turned slightly away

scenes.action: Sam proudly shows off his first stock certificate; his sister thinks it is worthless paper.
props: ornate cream stock certificate with a decorative brown engraved border and a signature line

scenes.title: Sam buys and counts at the shop counter

characters.pose: on tiptoe at the counter facing camera, carefully counting a row of coins out of his small brown leather coin purse
behind the counter, partly in the foreground from behind/three-quarter, one hand resting on the brass cash register

scenes.action: Sam buys a case of goods wholesale, counting out every coin of his savings.
props: small brown leather coin purse with clasp
neat row of coins on the counter

text_elements.location: the chalkboard price sign behind the counter

scenes.title: Closing the deal: SOLD at $40

characters.pose: dead center behind a wide dark-wood desk, pressing a wooden rubber stamp onto a certificate
three brokers on each side of Sam in fedoras and long coats, clapping politely

scenes.action: Sam sells his shares for more than he paid and stamps the deal closed while brokers applaud.
props: ticker tape machine on the left wall

text_elements.location: the center of the chalkboard in large chalk numerals
the certificate as a red rubber-stamp imprint

scenes.title: Mentor explains the profit math

characters.pose: standing at the chalkboard on the right, wearing round wire spectacles, pointing at the final line with a wooden pointer
standing on the left looking up at the board, satchel on hip, mouth open in a small 'o', star sparkles in his eyes

scenes.action: Mr. Vance shows Sam how $38 a share became $40 a share across 3 shares.
props: green banker's lamp on the mahogany desk

scenes.title: Split screen: small start vs. big breakout

characters.pose: seated at the small wooden desk, writing in a ledger with a pencil, a few short stacks of coins beside him

panels.label: NOW — the breakout
panels.setting_details: same warm room seen at night, a big chalkboard chart dominates the wall

characters.pose: standing in front of the chalkboard, both mitten hands raised, looking up at the chart

props: chalkboard line chart that is flat then spikes sharply up to the top-right corner
tall stacks of coins and paper bills on a desk
panels.accent: a single vivid profit-green (#2FA84F) chart line and upward arrow on the chalkboard
